result.instructions: Tools for A2X, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which A2X accounts are connected, and when was each last synced?"; "List the latest SKU cost file for my Amazon account and show the first 20 costs."; "Run a subledger query for orders by month this year and show the totals.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes A2X data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run a2xaccounting_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run a2xaccounting_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run a2xaccounting_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. a2xaccounting_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_create_data_export
tools.title: Create a data export
tools.description: WRITE: generate a CSV export (SKUS_BY_QUANTITY, SALES_BY_GL_AND_TYPE or SALES_BY_GL_TYPE_AND_DESC) for one account and calendar month. It stores the file for 15 days and counts against the 15-per-day quota. Not available for SKUS_BY_QUANTITY on PayPal. A2X: POST /api/v1/data-exports.

includeTaxRatesAndCountries.description: Break down by tax rate and country (default false).

tools.name: a2xaccounting_list_subledger_topics
tools.title: List subledger topics
tools.description: List the subledger topics (queryable data sets) for an organization. Needs an A2X Clarity or Subledger subscription and the subledger API enabled; otherwise HTTP 403. A2X: GET /api/v1/subledger/topics.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_get_subledger_topic
tools.title: Get a subledger topic
tools.description: Get one subledger topic: its fields, query rules, default filters and sample queries. Needs the Clarity or Subledger subscription. A2X: GET /api/v1/subledger/topics/{topic}.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_estimate_subledger_query
tools.title: Estimate a subledger query
tools.description: Check a subledger query and return how much data it would scan, without running it. Free; refuses the same queries the run tool refuses. Use it before a large query. Needs the Clarity or Subledger subscription. A2X: POST /api/v1/subledger/query/estimate.

field.description: A dimension or measure of the query.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_run_subledger_query
tools.title: Run a subledger query
tools.description: Run a read-only query on one subledger topic and return its rows (at most 5000 per call; use offset to page). Scan limit 50 GB, 60 s. Limited per organization across all tokens. Needs the Clarity or Subledger subscription. A2X: POST /api/v1/subledger/query.
